template.style: Vintage artistic portrait, cinematic film grain texture, warm brown tones with deep dark contrasts, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, low-angle upward shot emphasizing volumetric depth and atmospheric tension.

body.posture: relaxed yet theatrically poised on armchair
body.pose: seated confidently facing camera head-on with legs boldly spread apart in low-angle perspective for dramatic emphasis
body.gesture: Left arm casually resting against chair back for support, right hand delicately cupping cheek from the side with fingertips subtly curved in a thoughtful gesture.

wardrobe.outerwear: open unbuttoned deep navy blue tailored suit jacket with diamond brooch on lapel
wardrobe.bottom: high-waisted wide-leg beige trousers cinched by wide brown leather belt

environment.set: classic light taupe antique velvet armchair with curved armrests, against rear wall with thick draped vertical striped curtains creating shadows
environment.props: exquisite diamond brooch on jacket lapel

key.modifier: steep angle sidelight with rim highlights
key.effect: intense sidelight illuminating left side of face, shoulder, arm, brooch, and trouser folds; soft graduated shadows on back, chair, and curtains.

lighting.ambient: warm ambient glows with subtle lens flares

framing.crop: full upper body to thighs with centered composition
framing.angle: low-angle upward shot from below, accentuating the open-legged pose and creating exaggerated perspective

postprocess.texture: photorealistic with subtle film grain, scratches, and vignette edges
postprocess.sharpen: selective on facial features and fabric details

quality_targets: accurate limb lengths and joint angles
negative_prompt: no altered or exaggerated body proportions
no extreme distortion beyond low-angle perspective
